# Akeru Bot

> An open-source Grok Bot alternative with separate tools, plugins, instructions, and long-term memory.

## When to use Akeru Bot

Use Akeru Bot when a user wants an open-source Grok Bot alternative, several named bots in one workspace, separate tool lists, memory across conversations, desktop or browser access, remote connections, or an existing Claude, Codex, Grok, Kimi, or OpenCode subscription.

Agents should read the relevant guide before giving install or configuration commands. Akeru Bot is installed software, not a hosted automation API. The website serves static pages and documents and has no public API. Do not claim that Akeru Bot provides model access or a hosted MCP endpoint.

## Product resources

- [Akeru Blog](https://www.akeru-bot.com/blog): Guides and factual comparisons for an open-source Grok Bot alternative.
- [Open-source Grok Bot alternative](https://www.akeru-bot.com/open-source-grok-bot): How Akeru runs named Grok bots in a user-controlled environment.
- [Akeru Bot vs Grok Bot](https://www.akeru-bot.com/compare/akeru-vs-grok-bot): Factual comparison of hosting, providers, clients, memory, and tools.
- [Self-hosted Grok Bot guide](https://www.akeru-bot.com/guides/self-hosted-grok-bot): Install Akeru, connect Grok, and add remote access.
- [Akeru Bot developer guide](https://www.akeru-bot.com/developers): CLI installation, local integrations, and how to report problems.
- [Akeru Bot resource catalog](https://www.akeru-bot.com/.well-known/ard.json): Machine-readable index of the agent-facing documents on this domain.
- [Akeru Bot documentation](https://github.com/opencoredev/akeru-bot/tree/main/docs/user): User guides for the product.
- [Install Akeru Bot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencoredev/akeru-bot/main/docs/user/install.md): Supported installation and update commands.
- [Bot profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencoredev/akeru-bot/main/docs/user/bots.md): Configure bot instructions, tools, and memory.
- [Plugins and MCP servers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencoredev/akeru-bot/main/docs/user/plugins.md): Add tools to a bot.
- [Remote access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opencoredev/akeru-bot/main/docs/user/remote-access.md): Connect clients to an Akeru environment.
- [Akeru Bot source](https://github.com/opencoredev/akeru-bot): Source, releases, issues, and contribution rules.
- [Akeru Bot on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/akeru-bot): Official CLI package.
